description: This Java class 'TbResource' extends 'TbResourceInfo' and manages resource data, including encoding/decoding byte arrays to Base64 strings, and provides methods for resource data handling within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbResource
classes.description: A data class representing a resource with binary data and preview, supporting JSON serialization and Base64 encoding/decoding.

methods.name: getEncodedData
methods.description: Returns the 'data' byte array encoded as a Base64 string for JSON serialization.

methods.name: setEncodedData
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string from JSON and sets it as the 'data' byte array.

methods.name: getEncodedPreview
methods.description: Returns the 'preview' byte array encoded as a Base64 string for JSON serialization.

methods.name: setEncodedPreview
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string from JSON and sets it as the 'preview' byte array.

methods.name: toResourceDataInfo
methods.description: Converts the resource to a TbResourceDataInfo object, including data and descriptor.
